why: An author repairing a removed region should land on its goal field rather than hunt inside a collapsed chapter.
implementation: Native missing-region validation emits a distinct exact field path for every missing reference, including nested all/any groups. The existing journal navigation reveals and focuses that field.
browser: Public incomplete-draft export/import, visible and focused missing-region selector without manual expansion, repair, exact reload and original project isolation pass with no page errors and completed cleanup.

limits: Nested paths are covered natively; this browser fixture covers one direct regional goal. Other validation categories and unfamiliar-player acceptance remain separate.
